name_note: Published sources write this genus as Cryptobacteroides or Candidatus Cryptobacteroides.

sentences.text: Cryptobacteroides is counted among anaerobic gut bacterial genera; in faecal metagenomes of wild and domestic equids, genomes co-carrying resistance genes and mobile elements were assigned to it.
A cross-sectional gut microbiome study of 1,801 women from Burkina Faso, Ghana, Kenya and South Africa reported loss of Cryptobacteroides species in urban populations.
A study of three peninsular Malaysian populations reported the genus Cryptobacteroides enriched in rural individuals, while other genera were more prevalent among urban individuals.
In a mouse model of colitis, a study reported that lacto-N-biose treatment decreased Cryptobacteroides while promoting Akkermansia.
